title: Industry Report | 2023 TikTok Ecosystem Study
summary: Market size. Global short-video market → ~$135.9B by 2025. Tiers: N.America #1 (~$58.5B; 580M netizens, 70% SV pen, ARPU ~$143.7); Europe+Asia #2; LatAm/Oceania #3; Africa #4. TikTok ecommerce 2023 GMV target $23B; ads 2024 ~$23.58B. FastData: 2022 TTS GMV ~$4.3B (=5× 2021);

html:
Unique Research · Insight / industry study · March 10, 2023 · Full rewrite — not a stub · Data: UTen live (ID/UK/TH/VN/MY) + FastData full stack (+PH); 2022 full-year estimates

Market size. Global short-video market → ~$135.9B by 2025. Tiers: N.America #1 (~$58.5B; 580M netizens, 70% SV pen, ARPU ~$143.7); Europe+Asia #2; LatAm/Oceania #3; Africa #4. TikTok ecommerce 2023 GMV target $23B; ads 2024 ~$23.58B. FastData: 2022 TTS GMV ~$4.3B (=5× 2021); H1’22 already >$1B (=2021 full year). Live GMV ~¥6B with ID >70% / UK <30%. 5-yr GMV ambition cited ~$470B. Path: take share from other ecom + lift consumer value; SEA ecom 2025 ~$128.4B / US ~$468.3B.

Ads. eMarketer: TikTok ads $3.88B (2021) → ~$11.64B (2022, +200%) > Twitter+Snap combined; 2024 $23.58B (5yr CAGR 133%). US ads $2.095B in 2021 (~1% US digital); 2024 ~$11.013B (3yr CAGR ~74%). Ads live since early 2019 UK/US; Q1’22 ad-platform visits +200%.

Ecosystem vendors. Training TSPs (onboarding courses/camps); talent TSPs (recruit→supply streamers to industrial belts); ops TSPs (proxy-live, distribution, content, account ops, brand full-ops); brand TSP (proxy-live + creator match); industrial-belt TSP (supply-chain distribution); cross-border TAP (merchant↔creator affiliate); recruiting TSPs; data vendors doubling as TAP/recruiting TSP; marketing/ad agencies (media buy, KOL, campaigns).

TTS timeline. Oct 2020 Shopify partnership → JP/TH/ID pin carts; Feb 2021 ID live commerce + local shop (Shopee cart); Apr–Jul 2021 UK shop (local then CN/HK licensees); Aug 2021 Shopify carts US/UK/CA. Stage ≈ Douyin 2018–19. By end-2022: cross-border live in 7 countries (ID/UK/TH/VN/MY/PH/SG) + N.America via partners. SEA ecom $50B (2015) → $150B (2025) = 30×.

Country data chapters (ID/UK/TH/VN/MY/PH GMV, creators, categories) + outlook in CN images — attach on ingest.

— END —
